title: Evaluating Conversational Explainability in Healthcare: Comparing the Explainability Assistant and a Traditional XAI Dashboard
summary: Gemini selected and delivered explanations in a counterbalanced five-person healthcare-background pilot; four participants found the intended local feature in the conversational task, a small human-factors result rather than evidence of clinical benefit.
